verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm. A Song of David.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm [and] Song of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song.

verses.he: לְךָ֤ דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּצִיֹּ֑ון וּ֝לְךָ֗ יְשֻׁלַּם־נֶֽדֶר׃
verses.ar: لَكَ يَنْبَغِي ٱلتَّسْبِيحُ يَا ٱللهُ فِي صِهْيَوْنَ، وَلَكَ يُوفَى ٱلنَّذْرُ.
verses.en: Praise waiteth for Thee, O God, in Zion; and unto Thee the vow is performed.
verses.kjv: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.web: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

verses.ar: يَا سَامِعَ ٱلصَّلَاةِ، إِلَيْكَ يَأْتِي كُلُّ بَشَرٍ.
verses.en: O Thou that hearest prayer, unto Thee doth all flesh come.
verses.kjv: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.web: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

verses.he: דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֹנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּי פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗ינוּ אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽם׃
verses.ar: آثَامٌ قَدْ قَوِيَتْ عَلَيَّ. مَعَاصِينَا أَنْتَ تُكَفِّرُ عَنْهَا.
verses.en: The tale of iniquities is too heavy for me; as for our transgressions, Thou wilt pardon them.
verses.kjv: Iniquities prevail against me: [as for] our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.web: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֤י ׀ תִּֽבְחַ֣ר וּתְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֪ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥יךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلَّذِي تَخْتَارُهُ وَتُقَرِّبُهُ لِيَسْكُنَ فِي دِيَارِكَ. لَنَشْبَعَنَّ مِنْ خَيْرِ بَيْتِكَ، قُدْسِ هَيْكَلِكَ.
verses.en: Happy is the man whom Thou choosest, and bringest near, that he may dwell in Thy courts; may we be satisfied with the goodness of Thy house, the holy place of Thy temple!
verses.kjv: Blessed [is the man whom] thou choosest, and causest to approach [unto thee, that] he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, [even] of thy holy temple.
verses.web: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

verses.he: נֹ֤ורָאֹ֨ות ׀ בְּצֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כָּל־קַצְוֵי־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וְיָ֣ם רְחֹקִֽים׃
verses.ar: بِمَخَاوِفَ فِي ٱلْعَدْلِ تَسْتَجِيبُنَا يَا إِلَهَ خَلَاصِنَا، يَا مُتَّكَلَ جَمِيعِ أَقَاصِي ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْبَعِيدَةِ.
verses.en: With wondrous works dost Thou answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation; Thou the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of the far distant seas;
verses.kjv: [By] terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; [who art] the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off [upon] the sea:
verses.web: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

verses.en: Who by Thy strength settest fast the mountains, who art girded about with might;
verses.kjv: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; [being] girded with power:
verses.web: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

verses.he: מַשְׁבִּ֤יחַ ׀ שְׁאֹ֣ון יַ֭מִּים שְׁאֹ֥ון גַּלֵּיהֶ֗ם וַהֲמֹ֥ון לְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.ar: ٱلْمُهْدِّئُ عَجِيجَ ٱلْبِحَارِ، عَجِيجَ أَمْوَاجِهَا، وَضَجِيجَ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.en: Who stillest the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples;
verses.kjv: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.web: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

verses.he: וַיִּ֤ירְא֨וּ ׀ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֹת מֵאֹותֹתֶ֑יךָ מֹ֤וצָֽאֵי־בֹ֖קֶר וָעֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין׃
verses.ar: وَتَخَافُ سُكَّانُ ٱلْأَقَاصِي مِنْ آيَاتِكَ. تَجْعَلُ مَطَالِعَ ٱلصَّبَاحِ وَٱلْمَسَاءِ تَبْتَهِجُ.
verses.en: So that they that dwell in the uttermost parts stand in awe of Thy signs; Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.kjv: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.web: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

verses.he: פָּקַ֥דְתָּ הָאָ֨רֶץ ׀ וַתְּשֹׁ֪קְקֶ֡הָ רַבַּ֬ת תַּעְשְׁרֶ֗נָּה פֶּ֣לֶג אֱ֭לֹהִים מָ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם תָּכִ֥ין דְּ֝גָנָ֗ם כִּי־כֵ֥ן תְּכִינֶֽהָ׃
verses.ar: تَعَهَّدْتَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلْتَهَا تَفِيضُ. تُغْنِيهَا جِدًّا. سَوَاقِي ٱللهِ مَلآنَةٌ مَاءً. تُهَيِّئُ طَعَامَهُمْ لِأَنَّكَ هَكَذَا تُعِدُّهَا.
verses.en: Thou hast remembered the earth, and watered her, greatly enriching her, with the river of God that is full of water; Thou preparest them corn, for so preparest Thou her.
verses.kjv: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, [which] is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.web: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

verses.he: תְּלָמֶ֣יהָ רַ֭וֵּה נַחֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֶ֑יהָ בִּרְבִיבִ֥ים תְּ֝מֹגְגֶ֗נָּה צִמְחָ֥הּ תְּבָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.ar: أَرْوِ أَتْلَامَهَا. مَهِّدْ أَخَادِيدَهَا. بِٱلْغُيُوثِ تُحَلِّلُهَا. تُبَارِكُ غَلَّتَهَا.
verses.en: Watering her ridges abundantly, settling down the furrows thereof, Thou makest her soft with showers; Thou blessest the growth thereof.
verses.kjv: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.web: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

verses.he: עִ֭טַּרְתָּ שְׁנַ֣ת טֹובָתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מַעְגָּלֶ֗יךָ יִרְעֲפ֥וּן דָּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.ar: كَلَّلْتَ ٱلسَّنَةَ بِجُودِكَ، وَآثَارُكَ تَقْطُرُ دَسَمًا.
verses.en: Thou crownest the year with Thy goodness; and Thy paths drop fatness.
verses.kjv: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.web: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

verses.he: יִ֭רְעֲפוּ נְאֹ֣ות מִדְבָּ֑ר וְ֝גִ֗יל גְּבָעֹ֥ות תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה׃
verses.ar: تَقْطُرُ مَرَاعِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ، وَتَتَنَطَّقُ ٱلْآكَامُ بِٱلْبَهْجَةِ.
verses.en: The pastures of the wilderness do drop; and the hills are girded with joy.
verses.kjv: They drop [upon] the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.web: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

verses.he: לָבְשׁ֬וּ כָרִ֨ים ׀ הַצֹּ֗אן וַעֲמָקִ֥ים יַֽעַטְפוּ־בָ֑ר יִ֝תְרֹועֲע֗וּ אַף־יָשִֽׁירוּ׃
verses.ar: ٱكْتَسَتِ ٱلْمُرُوجُ غَنَمًا، وَٱلْأَوْدِيَةُ تَتَعَطَّفُ بُرًّا. تَهْتِفُ وَأَيْضًا تُغَنِّي.
verses.en: The meadows are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, yea, they sing.
verses.kjv: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.web: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
